messages:
alex: Hey team — removed a bunch of dead, feature-flagged handlers from the model-router PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/1428 PTAL. Addressed @jamie and @sara's comments, fixed the failing test, and updated the changelog. Planning to merge today if no objections.

jamie: Quick Q — the refactor touches the request path; did you run the e2e smoke? I saw a flake earlier.

alex: Yep, ran smoke locally and in staging. The specific flake was nil ctx in handler; I added a guard. Command I used: `./scripts/run-smoke.sh --env=staging`

leo: Any perf impact? This touches a hot path so want to double-check.

alex: Ran a quick benchmark: p50 before 12.3ms -> after 12.4ms, p95 before 58.0ms -> after 59.1ms (10k reqs). Noise-level change. Also added a micro-benchmark at `tests/bench/request_path_bench.go`.

sara: Code looks good to me, left one nit about comment wording (not blocking). PTAL @jamie for perf confirmation. Also prefer squashed commit history for this cleanup.

jamie: I can re-run perf in the morning; OK to merge after CI passes and one more perf run. I also prefer squash.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed — unit, lint, integration (https://ci.redwood-inference/builds/9891) :white_check_mark:

alex: Thanks — addressed the nit and force-pushed. PTAL again. I'll wait for one more perf run and merge in ~30m if green.

sara: :thumbsup:

leo: No objections from me.

alex: Merging now. Thanks y'all — I'll watch the canary for 30m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `inference-model-router` version `v1.8.3-canary` (canary region: us-west-2).
